changes: Added CARB and Canada VOC limits
Currency review only; no regulatory substance data was changed.

Primary sources (ifrafragrance.org, eur-lex.europa.eu, oehha.ca.gov, canada.ca, echa.europa.eu) were not reachable from the review environment (egress proxy returned 403), so the findings below come from secondary web-search summaries and are UNVERIFIED.

pending_review.finding: 52nd Amendment consultation closed 2026-06-12; End of Consultation Letter dated 2026-08-31; formal notification expected ~late Nov 2026. 51st remains current_amendment until then. Effective dates not confirmed.
Reg (EU) 2023/1545 labelling applies from 2026-07-31 for new products and 2028-07-31 for products already on the market (per secondary sources); confirm against the Official Journal text.

Health Canada consultation on proposed Hotlist updates ran 2025-11-19 to 2026-02-17 (proposals incl. Basic Violet 4, Basic Blue 7, furocoumarins amendment). No final revision confirmed; CAS numbers/wording not verified so no entries added.

Reported 2026 listings (hydrochlorothiazide, voriconazole, tacrolimus, welding fumes; reportedly effective 2026-07-17) are not fragrance-relevant and were not added. Fragrance-relevant additions since March 2026 not checked against OEHHA's list.
ECHA Candidate List reportedly grew from 251 to 253 entries in Feb 2026 (n-hexane; bisphenol AF and salts). Later 2026 updates not checked. Not added (not fragrance-specific; not confirmed on ECHA).
Canada SOR/2021-268 consolidation reportedly unchanged since 2023-01-01 (current to 2026-06-14). CARB limits not rechecked.

notes: To update regulatory data, edit the corresponding JSON files in data/regulatory/ and update this metadata file with the new version and date. Datasets other than the 2026-10-16 review entry reflect the dates in their own metadata.last_updated; those dates were not advanced because no primary-source verification was possible.
